parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 500. The default value is 500
parameters.help_zh: 条数；正整数，大于0，最大不能超过500， 默认为500
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to skip before returning results. The value must be a non-negative integer. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 第几条开始；正整数 大于等于0 默认为0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The sort order by creation time. Valid values: `0` (ascending) and `1` (descending)
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式,按照创建时间排序；0正序 1倒序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The start of the creation time range for the query. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the creation time range for the query. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.name: end_time

AnnouncePosition.description_en: Specifies when to announce the caller's position in the queue. Valid values: `0` (disabled), `1` (announce when position > `AnnouncePositionParam`), and `2` (announce when position <= `AnnouncePositionParam`)
AnnouncePosition.description_zh: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放
AnnouncePosition.title_en: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放
AnnouncePosition.title_zh: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放

AnnouncePositionFrequency.description_en: The announcement interval for the queue position, in seconds

AnnouncePositionParam.description_en: The threshold for the queue position announcement
AnnouncePositionParam.title_en: 多余少余n个时播报，必须大于等于2
AnnouncePositionParam.title_zh: 多余少余n个时播报，必须大于等于2

AnnouncePositionYouarenext.title_zh: 是否播报'您是下一位',0关闭，1开启

CreateTime.title_zh: 创建时间，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

JoinEmpty.description_en: Specifies the conditions for joining a queue with no available agents. Valid values: `1` (Busy), `2` (In a call), `4` (Ringing), `8` (Invalid), and `16` (Wrap-up)
JoinEmpty.description_zh: 队列中为空时是否可以join，取值：1：置忙 2：通话中 4：振铃 8：无效 16：整理

Weight.description_zh: 队列优先级，取值范围1-10，数值越高，优先级越高
